request: Draw the single-line diagram of a French house (NF C 15-100): TT earthing, single-phase 230 V (1P+N), 12 kVA supply with a 500 mA selective main breaker. Three 30 mA residual-current groups (at least one type A for the hob and washing machine, the others type AC) protecting lighting, socket, hob, washing machine and heating circuits with cables. The 200 L water heater is on an off-peak (HC) contactor driven by the meter.
